mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.6% triggers a loss of consumer confidence and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 3.6%, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant negative relationship.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and business activity (HOUST) signals robust demand, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a baseline period with similar demand proxies, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, persistent federal funds rates below 2.0% indicate accommodative monetary policy, lowering borrowing costs and enhancing equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform a 60-day baseline in late-cycle periods, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 20,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic growth, attracting capital to equities and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 crosses above 20,000, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Stronger supply-side indicators (INDPRO) and demand-side activity (RSAFS) both rising above historical levels signal balanced economic growth, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and RSAFS exceed 105 and 683,974 respectively
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a balanced growth baseline, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market tightening (UNRATE > 3.5%), a concurrent rise in federal funds rates above 2.5% signals aggressive monetary policy, amplifying inflationary pressures and dampening equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the trigger, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above 105 reflects robust production capacity, reducing resource scarcity and boosting market confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline supply levels, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.
